operators.name: softplus_forward
semantics: Computes elementwise softplus: if x_i * beta > threshold, output_i = x_i; else output_i = log1p(exp(x_i * beta)) / beta.
Uses beta=1.0 and threshold=20.0 by default, matching torch.nn.Softplus default parameters.
Input must be a CUDA float32 tensor.

operators.name: concat_forward

parameters.name: x1
parameters.shape: same as x2 except concat dim

parameters.name: x2
parameters.shape: same as x1 except concat dim

returns.shape: concatenation of x1 and x2 along dim

semantics: Concatenates x1 and x2 along the specified dim exactly like torch.cat((x1,x2), dim=dim).
Inputs must have the same shape except in the concatenation dimension.
Output shape is determined by summing sizes along concat dim and keeping other dims unchanged.
Elementwise softplus applied to input x1 with beta=1.0, threshold=20.0.
Output shape [64,3,1024,512], dtype float32, device cuda:0.
Elementwise softplus applied to input x2 with beta=1.0, threshold=20.0.
Output shape [64,3,1024,512], dtype float32, device cuda:0.
Concatenates x1 and x2 along dim=1.
Output shape [64,6,1024,512], dtype float32, device cuda:0.
